title: Aspirin + Enoxaparin Co-administration Alert
description: Concomitant use of Aspirin and Clexane increases severe gastrointestinal and systemic hemorrhage risk.

title: NSAID + ACE-Inhibitor / ARB Renal Warning
description: Ibuprofen paired with Telmisartan can attenuate antihypertensive effect and precipitate acute kidney injury.

title: Penicillin Class Allergy Warning
description: Patient has known allergy to Penicillin. Prescribing Augmentin (Amoxicillin) risks anaphylaxis.

title: Sulfa Drug Hypersensitivity Alert
description: Patient allergic to Sulfonamides. Check cross-reactivity with prescribed diuretics or oral hypoglycemics.

title: Stage 2 Hypertensive Crisis Alert
description: Systolic blood pressure >= 160 mmHg or Diastolic >= 100 mmHg recorded. Immediate physician review needed.

title: Tachycardia Alert
description: Resting heart rate >= 120 bpm recorded. Perform ECG and assess volume status.

title: Severe Hypoxia Alert
description: SpO2 level below 92% detected on room air. Initiate oxygen therapy immediately.

title: Metformin in Renal Impairment
description: Metformin contraindicated or dose reduction required when Serum Creatinine > 1.5 mg/dL due to lactic acidosis risk.

title: Hypothermia / High Fever Alert
description: Body temperature above 103.0 F detected. Prescribe antipyretics and infectious workup.

title: Aspirin-Exacerbated Respiratory Disease
description: Patient has Aspirin/NSAID allergy with history of bronchial asthma.
